value.rationale: A complete and naturally motivated centralizer-size spectrum and ordered commutation probability for the *entire* finite jet endomorphism monoid, extending beyond unit-only group descriptions. The coefficientwise proof reveals an unexpected exact characteristic-two versus odd-characteristic leading-coefficient split and proves the sharp cutoff lengths 4 versus 2. These are structural invariants for an unbounded family of field orders, not a small finite recomputation.
